text:
noah: Customer can't get past "first call". Starter curl returns 402 but CLI shows only "Request failed (402)" so they thought key was wrong. They joined via an org invite created by SCIM automation.

priya: Can you paste the exact curl + response body? We need to know whether it's billing_required vs scope error.

noah: From support transcript:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.test/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_test_zzz' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"hello"}'
```
HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
Body: {"error":{"code":"billing_required","message":"workspace_incomplete"}}

mike: That's onboarding. We recently saw SCIM-created orgs where the console onboarding CTA isn't injected into the invite flow, so users don't land on billing.

priya: Short-term support guidance: tell customers to open Console -> Billing or visit https://console.redwood-inference.test/onboarding to complete setup. Add this to the new-hire/SCIM KB.

devex-bot: Filed: DEVEX-780 - CLI/SDK should surface onboarding reason and any onboarding_url from API. Workaround KB: https://go.redwood/onboard-scimgap :warning:

noah: Suggestion for API: when org.status != "active" return error fields: onboarding_required:true and onboarding_url. Then SDKs can present a clear CTA and the CLI can print a helpful message instead of numeric status.

mike: Also propose new SDK error type FirstCallOnboardingRequired with .onboarding_url property, so apps can render a button. I'll draft the SDK patch.

support-bot: Customer reported they completed billing via the console and the same curl returned 200 immediately. Block duration: ~15 minutes.

priya: I'll add a tiny quickstart note: "If you were invited to an org you might need to finish billing in the Console before your first API request will succeed." Also adding a link to the KB.

noah: Great, leaving this thread bookmarked so support can point customers here. If someone wants to pair on CLI UX text I can join tomorrow.
